Subject: Quick recap + ask: payment route and stakeholder heatmap for Redwood pilot

Laura — thanks again for the time this morning. Short recap from our side and a few asks so we can prepare the vendor packet for your procurement team.

Call highlights (2/3):
- Pilot scope: 3 models, inference via Redwood hosted API for payments reconciliation assistant.
- Expected monthly tokens: ~1.2M; peak latency SLO: 300ms p95.
- Primary value metric: reduction in manual reconciliation time (estimated 40 hours/mo).

Open asks for procurement/ops so we can map owners and timeline:
1) Economic buyer: who signs the SOW/commit? (name + email)
2) Procurement path: do you require a PO for services? If yes, is there a minimum threshold and which system (Workday/Netsuite/Other)?
3) Invoicing/payment route: ACH, wire, or vendor portal? Any special remit address or vendor codes we should populate?
4) Vendor onboarding: preferred intake form, tax docs (W-9 or W-8), and sample SLA/insurance proof required.
5) Timeline: typical vendor intake -> PO issuance after legal review (estimate in business days).

Attachments I'm preparing and can send immediately: vendor intake template, redwood SOW draft, and a sample invoice. Would you prefer these uploaded to your vendor portal or emailed?

Next steps proposed:
- You confirm (1)-(4) above and introduce the procurement/contact (Ben or procurement@) we should loop in.
- I’ll send completed vendor intake + W-9 and a short payment routing sheet for your AP team.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement if that speeds things up.

Regards,
David Kim
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Thanks David — great convo. Quick answers below to help you build the packet: 

1) Economic buyer: Ben Yates (CFO) — ben.yates@helixfin.com. He signs SOWs > $25k.
2) Procurement path: Yes, we require a PO for ongoing services. Our procurement team issues POs from Workday. POs are required for any vendor spend > $5k, otherwise procurement approves via case.
3) Invoicing/payment route: We prefer vendor portal for invoice submission; ACH or wire are standard. Remit: Helix Financial, c/o AP Team (details sent after vendor creation). Net45 is standard, but we can discuss Net30 for pilots.
4) Vendor onboarding: We need a completed vendor intake form, a W-9 (for US entities), proof of insurance (if applicable), and standard AML/KYC questionnaire for third-party vendors.
5) Timeline: From completed intake + legal signoff, procurement typically issues a PO in 7-15 business days. If Ben needs to review pricing/commit, add another 5 business days.

Action items from Helix: I’m looping in procure@ (copied). Ben — happy to take a quick note if you want to own the SOW signoff.

We have a vendor portal link for uploads: https://vendors.helixfin.com/upload (Procurement team will confirm exact file types).

If you can send the W-9 and intake form today, procurement will queue it. Otherwise we can schedule the 15-min intake call with procurement + Ben.
